about: Royal Caribbean International sailings that depart Port Canaveral (PCN), Cape Canaveral, Florida 32920. Prices are the public starting fare per person in USD from Royal Caribbean's cruise search, before taxes and fees, for Interior, Ocean View, and Balcony. perNight is that starting fare divided by nights. bestValue marks the lowest per-night fare. under100 marks sailings under $100 a night. fetchedAt is when this file was last filled. A failed fetch keeps the previous deals.
